summary: Each merge poll reads the newest merge-queue timeline event. The first answer is the baseline. A later removal that is not a merge ends an open wait on the watched head as failure, before check failures and despite UNSTABLE. Failed merge-group runs are best-effort detail. A queue read failure is an error. gh api calls are fixed queries, and repo must be owner/name.
title: A merge wait ends when the merge queue removes the pull request
